issues.what: the globe never moves: no lift, no strokes, no tilt, no set down - it sits bolted to the surface in an identical pose in every frame while only the interior storms into a milk ball; the scattered petals and reflection likewise stay frozen, so the shake reads as a snow effect triggered on a parked globe that weighs nothing
issues.fix: animate the globe as a heavy hand-held object: unequal strokes with sharp reversals, a tilt that lags the strokes, a visible effort on the lift, a landing that bounces once and settles - camera locked, reflection and loose petals answering the motion

issues.what: the base and surroundings pop: the dark moss base and petal-strewn reflective surface become a cream gem-studded base on bare sand-dusted ground in one step while the tabletop is fully in view - only the globe interior is masked by the storm, so the eye catches the base and the surface changing outright
issues.fix: hide the whole swap, not just the interior: carry matching petals/surface across the storm and transition the base and ground gradually under full cover (dip to shadow, blur, or camera move), never a one-frame exchange

issues.where: the at-rest hold, across the full 24.00s-33.57s (worst 30.10s vs 30.97s, frames 1806 vs 1858)
issues.what: the interior keeps re-rendering at rest: the tree canopy reshapes, lamp positions move, the house and the base's gem inlays morph between frames, so the hero scene crawls and shimmers in exactly the fine branches and small lights the stability check forbids; the scene is not one stable globe with drifting snow but a slowly boiling image
issues.fix: lock the interior scene and base once arrived; animate only the particles and light - no per-generation drift of trees, lamps, house or inlays across the rest hold

issues.where: the arrival across all eight sheets (24.00s-26.97s; adjacent frames 0.03s apart, e.g. 1584 vs 1586)
issues.what: per-frame shimmer during the arrival: canopy silhouette, lamp positions, house detail and the sand-grain sparkle at the base edge change every frame, so the playing shot will boil around the tree and house even though the season does correctly grow in rather than wipe on
issues.fix: hold the arriving scene's geometry stable frame to frame and let growth, snow and light carry the motion; regenerate detail only on a locked base

issues.what: the liquid has no readable physics: it blooms to a featureless milk within half a second, hangs nearly static at 23.33s-23.53s, then simply thins to reveal drifting snow - no lag behind the glass, no slam, and no single slow whirl dying away is readable; the particles storm while the glass does nothing
issues.fix: choreograph the liquid: a visible vortex that lags and slams with the strokes, one unified slow whirl after the set down, and a graded settle onto surfaces

issues.what: a horizontal fill-line/reflection band cuts across the globe through the tree and shifts position between sampled frames, reading as a wobbling seam rather than a stable glass or liquid feature
issues.fix: keep the liquid surface and its reflection band fixed in height and shape, or remove the line entirely
